thread:
maria.gomez: Quick reminder — final CI pass for v2.5 cutoff at 18:00 UTC today. If you have any open PRs that need version bumps / changelog entries, please push them now or flag them. I'll lock main at 18:05 UTC. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex.chen: On it — need one more minute to bump the CLI version in #1234. Is a changelog entry required if it's only an internal refactor?

maria.gomez: yes please add a short changelog bullet under 'internal' so release notes match. small entries ok.

luis: PR 1240 is green but there are 2 flaky tests failing intermittently on Linux. @ci-bot can you re-run?

ci-bot: [ci] Re-triggering pipeline for PR 1240 — build/pytest started (job 4523).

jonah: pinging owners: @sophie the scheduler tests are failing in master vs your recent change — can you look? stacktrace:

```
tests/scheduler/test_schedule.py::test_overlap
E   AssertionError: Expected 2 events, got 1
  File "/workspace/tests/scheduler/test_schedule.py", line 47, in test_overlap
```

sophie: looking now. I saw a flake yesterday locally. Might be due to timezone mock. Trying a fix and will push shortly.

ranjit: FYI, if we can't stabilize those, we should mark them flaky in pytest markers so release isn't blocked. Better to add a quick skip with a ticket.

alex.chen: pushed version bump + changelog in #1234 — waiting for green. @maria.gomez can you confirm branch freeze time?

maria.gomez: branch freeze/lock at 18:05 UTC. If CI green before that, we'll merge; otherwise we'll cut without pending non-critical PRs. I'll leave a final comment at 18:00.

ci-bot: [ci] PR 1240 rerun finished — flaky test still failing (tests/scheduler/test_overlap). Full log: https://ci.example.com/build/4523

luis: I'm going to run the test locally with Docker, will report in 10m.

sophie: quick patch pushed that adds a timezone-safe mock. Running local pytest quick pass.

ci-bot: [ci] Desktop build for #1234: all checks passed. integration job succeeded.

maria.gomez: thanks — looks like we have green for the version bump. @alex.chen can you rebase and merge before 18:05?

alex.chen: rebased and merged at 18:01 UTC. changelog entry included. :tada:

maria.gomez: Nice work. I'll run the final smoke. If anyone sees post-merge CI flake, open a follow-up bug and tag 'release-blocker' if it fails gating checks.

ranjit: copied. prepping release notes draft from changelog entries now.
